Portronics JuiceMate 2 Travel Adapter – Compact Global Charging Solution

The Portronics JuiceMate 2 Travel Adapter is designed for modern travellers who need a safe, compact, and reliable way to power their devices anywhere. Whether you are on a business trip, vacation, or daily commute, this multi plug solution lets you charge smartphones, tablets, cameras, and other essentials with ease. With Model: JuiceMate 2, you get a sleek Black finish, universal compatibility, and dependable performance in one pocket-friendly design.

Built to match international travel needs, the Adapter supports a wide range of plug standards while maintaining strong safety protection. The AC Socket Output: 6A allows you to power compatible appliances efficiently, while the Dual USB-A Output: 12W enables fast and simultaneous charging for two USB devices. If you want a universal travel adapter that balances portability and power, this is a smart everyday companion.

Key Features

  • Universal compatibility for charging in multiple countries
  • AC socket supports up to 6A for reliable appliance use
  • Dual USB-A ports with total 12W output for mobile devices
  • Compact, lightweight, and easy to pack
  • Built-in safety shutters and protection mechanisms
  • Ideal for smartphones, power banks, cameras, tablets & more

Travel-Friendly & Space Saving

The Portronics JuiceMate 2 Travel Adapter fits easily into backpacks, cabin luggage, or laptop bags. Its ergonomic build ensures you don’t have to carry separate chargers for different regions. Frequent flyers, digital nomads, and corporate travellers will appreciate the lightweight construction and durable materials that withstand daily use.

Charge Multiple Devices Together

With Dual USB-A Output: 12W, you can power two gadgets at the same time without hunting for extra sockets. Keep your phone and earbuds charging overnight or top up your tablet while working. The smart power distribution maintains stable output, helping protect your devices from overcurrent and overheating.

Reliable AC Power

The integrated AC Socket Output: 6A is suitable for many travel-friendly electronics such as laptop chargers, grooming tools, or small appliances. Designed for convenience, the socket offers a firm grip for plugs, reducing accidental slips during use.

Designed for Modern Users

Model: JuiceMate 2 blends minimal aesthetics with practical engineering. The elegant black body complements your tech gear, making it perfect for office setups, hotel rooms, and airport lounges. It’s a dependable accessory for anyone looking for a portable mobile charger and international plug adapter in one unit.

Why Choose This Universal Travel Adapter?

Instead of carrying multiple chargers, the simplifies your packing list. You get USB charging, AC connectivity, and travel-ready safety in a single device. For professionals and families alike, it ensures your essential electronics remain powered wherever your journey takes you.

Specifications

  • Product Name: Portronics JuiceMate 2 Travel Adapter
  • Model: JuiceMate 2
  • Colour: Black
  • AC Socket Output: 6A
  • USB Output: Dual USB-A, 12W
